mandate: C414 — test the cross-sectional intraday SIGNCO-MOTION: SAME-SIGN CO-MOTION vs EQUAL-WEIGHT MARKET stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; equal-weight market return m[s]=(1/10)*sum_i r_i[s]. SIGNCO-MOTION scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns: for each bar t, X=r_i[t-W+1..t], M=m[t-W+1..t], same[t]=1{sign(X)==sign(M)&both nonzero}; sign_agree[t]=mean(same) over window; sign_agree_asym[t]=mean(same|M>0)-mean(same|M<0). Needs indices t-W+1..t (W bars). NaN if t<W, any NaN/non-finite, or an up/down market conditional group is empty. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (sign_agree_dev, sign_agree_asym_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs and valid denominators; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar window or not finite or an up/down market conditional group empty).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|; market m[s]=mean across assets.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns; same[t]=1{sign(X)==sign(M)&both nonzero}; sign_agree=mean(same); sign_agree_asym=mean(same|M>0)-mean(same|M<0).
methodology.signals: sign_agree/sign_agree_asym over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.signcomotion_vectorization_note: return matrix R=(T,10) built once; market m[s]=mean across assets; zero-copy sliding_window_view(R,256) and sliding_window_view(m,256) processed in chunks; per-chunk same-sign mask vs market sign; conditional up/down agreement via masked sums/counts; validated against brute-force per-window loop with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests. Chunking keeps peak memory low.
